issues.title: [RAC1] Chairman Drek’s final boss music does not play in NTSC-U (OpenRAC and PCSX2)
issues.author: kwfrrb562c-boop
issues.body:
Hi developers,
I’ve been doing some testing with the PAL and NTSC-U versions of Ratchet & Clank 1, specifically regarding an issue where Chairman Drek’s final boss battle music fails to play.
Initially, I suspected this might be an OpenRAC issue. However, after testing both regional versions in OpenRAC and PCSX2, I’ve found that the problem appears to be specific to the NTSC-U release.
Test results
Game version	PCSX2	OpenRAC
PAL (SCES-50916)	Music plays correctly	Music plays correctly
NTSC-U…
